# cairn vault switch

Set the default vault

## Help

```text
Set the default vault

Usage: cairn vault switch [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  Name of the vault to make default

Options:
      --json                  Emit JSON output
      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>  Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides
                              CAIRN_VAULT)
  -h, --help                  Print help
```
